findings.title: No captured evidence for journey 'convergent-lock'
findings.narrative: The contract's user_journey 'convergent-lock' has zero captured EvidenceRef artifacts under any source surface (web/ios/android/backend). This is a coverage gap — the v1 auditor cannot tell whether the journey was implemented or whether evidence simply was not captured. Operator must either capture artifacts under the journey or record an explicit non-goal in the contract.
